mara_sales: Posting quick summary from the Acme POC ramp today. They wanted a mixed profile with short-chat heavy traffic plus occasional long generations. High level: sustained 220 qps mix, short-chat p95 ~210ms, chat p99 ~850ms, but long-gen p99 ~2.8s and a few spikes to ~4.1s. Errors ~0.6% (mostly long-gen timeouts). Need: pricing delta for a tiny reserved burst pool vs hosted, and completed security Q (BYOK/KMS + SSO notes).

jon_se: can you share the exact profile and the command you used? also confirm whether embedding batching and KV cache were enabled.

mara_sales: run we kicked off (loadrunner):

```
loadrunner start --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --concurrency 220 --duration 420s \
  --mix "chat:70,embed:20,long:10" --model redwood/gptx-7b:prod-int8 \
  --region us-west-2
```

KV cache: ON for chat. Embedding batching: OFF for baseline.

loadrunner: run_complete id=acme-2026-04-15-1 summary: qps=220 avg=110ms p95=210ms p99=900ms max=4120ms errors=0.6% error_types=[long_gen_timeouts] link=https://internal/runs/acme-2026-04-15-1.json

eli_infra: quick infra notes from logs: autoscaler observed spike and started provisioning at t+50s; vGPUs attached at t+170s due to allocation queue in this region's dedicated pool. Cold allocation + short burst window caused the tail. Also saw embedding worker threads CPU queuing when batching was off.

jon_se: mitigation checklist for next run: 1) enable adaptive embedding batching (batch window 20ms), 2) set burst_window_secs=200 to give autoscaler time, 3) prewarm 1 node if expecting repeated bursts, 4) increase long-gen timeout to 14s. Config example: 

{"adaptive_batching":"true","embedding_batch_ms":"20","burst_window_secs":"200","prewarm_nodes":"1","request_timeout_secs":"14"}

pax_prod: customer requirement: p95 < 250ms mixed, p99 < 1s for short chat, and BYOK with HSM-backed CMK. They also asked for a diagram of the KMS flow and confirmation we support SAML SSO. I'll own the security questionnaire.

mara_sales: sales ask: can we get a quick back-of-envelope pricing delta for a 2-node reserved pool (expected steady baseline handled by hosted, reserved pool used for long-gen stability during bursts)? ballpark numbers will do for the call tomorrow.

eli_infra: ballpark infra numbers: 2 vGPU nodes reserved => ~$3,200/month commit; expected per-token spend drops ~20% when moving long-gen to reserved; estimate combined monthly delta ~+$1,800 vs hosted-only for this workload. I'll flag finance for a formal quote.

jon_se: I'll PR the runbook with the config changes and a short how-to for prewarm + embedding batching. Will post link here when ready.

pax_prod: I'll attach the KMS flow diagram + completed questionnaire by EOD tomorrow.

mara_sales: great. Action items: jon -> runbook PR; eli -> confirm formal reserved quote + autoscale logs; pax -> security Q + KMS diagram; sales -> tabletop numbers for next call. Meeting scheduled Monday 09:00 PT with Acme to review tradeoffs.
